title: Define
intro: Phase 2: set the direction — the North Star, the strategic outcomes and their KPIs with dated targets, and the guardrails.

northStar.title: North Star
northStar.intro: One sentence that states the end state this transformation exists to reach.
northStar.hint: One sentence, one line, at most 300 characters.
northStar.notSetBody: The North Star is required for G2 (Direction).
northStar.conflict: Someone else changed the North Star meanwhile. The current statement is: “{{current}}”

outcomes.title: Strategic outcomes
outcomes.intro: The outcome tree. Mark 3 to 5 top outcomes. Each outcome is checked against the good outcome test.
outcomes.statementHint: State the result, not an activity (not just “launch”, “implement” or “deliver”).
outcomes.ownerHint: A named business leader who owns the outcome.
outcomes.causalChainHint: How the planned changes lead to this outcome.
outcomes.emptyBody: Add the strategic outcomes this transformation must achieve.

reasons.noEvaluator: This criterion cannot be evaluated in this release, so it stays unknown.

specific.pass: Confirmed as specific, and the statement names a result.
specific.activity: Not specific: the statement describes an activity (launch, implement, deliver), not the result it should produce.
specific.unknown: Not yet assessed: specificity is not confirmed.

measurable.pass: At least one KPI is linked in the Outcome & KPI Tree.
measurable.fail: No KPI linked: the outcome has no active T02 row.

strategically_relevant.unknown: Not yet assessed: strategic relevance is not confirmed.

owned_by_business_leader.noOwner: No owner set: the outcome is not owned by a business leader.
owned_by_business_leader.inactive: The owner is not an active user of the organization.

causal_chain.unknown: Not yet assessed: no causal chain is recorded.

guardrails.title: Strategic guardrails
guardrails.intro: Boundaries the transformation must respect (regulatory, customer experience, capital, risk, brand).

charter.title: Transformation Charter
charter.intro: The charter's 14 fields, the transformation thesis and the scope sanity checks. Every saved change is kept as a new version.
charter.emptyBody: G1 (Case for Change) needs an initial charter. Create it here; it starts as version 1.
charter.currentVersion: Showing charter version {{version}}, saved {{when}}. Saved versions are a working record, not an approval.
charter.fieldsIntro: The 14 fields of the playbook charter. Missing fields show Unknown.
charter.fieldsFormIntro: All fields can be completed over time; G1 checks which ones are still missing.
charter.northStarHint: The current North Star is set on the Define screen.
charter.horizonHint: A number with its unit, for example 18 months. Enter both or neither.
charter.changeSummaryHint: Optional: what changed and why (kept with the new version).
charter.warningGeneric: The charter has a warning that needs attention.
charter.topOutcomesWarning: {{n}} top outcomes: the charter should name 3 to 5 top outcomes.

thesis.title: Transformation thesis
thesis.pattern: We will change [what] to achieve [outcomes], creating [benefits], because [evidence and logic].

scope.title: Scope sanity checks
scope.intro: Five questions the sponsor and lead answer, each with evidence. The system pre-check is a hint from the recorded data, not an answer.
scope.question: Question
scope.precheckNote: Pre-checks read the recorded data only; they never answer a check for you.
scope.outcome_linkage: Is each scope item linked to a strategic outcome?
scope.problem_traceability: Can each scope item be traced to a diagnosed problem?
scope.executive_decisions_visible: Are the executive decisions needed visible?

outcome_linkage.attention: Check the link to the strategic outcomes.
outcome_linkage.unknown: Not enough data for a system pre-check.
outcome_linkage.not_applicable: Answered by people; no system pre-check.

problem_traceability.pass: Confirmed diagnostic findings exist to trace the scope to.
problem_traceability.attention: No confirmed diagnostic finding traces the scope yet.
problem_traceability.unknown: In-scope items are not recorded yet.
problem_traceability.not_applicable: Answered by people; no system pre-check.

exclusions_documented.pass: Explicit exclusions (out of scope) are documented.
exclusions_documented.unknown: No exclusions (out of scope) are recorded yet.
exclusions_documented.not_applicable: Answered by people; no system pre-check.

baseline_measurable.pass: At least one baseline has a value, a source and a date.
baseline_measurable.attention: No baseline has a value, a source and a date.
baseline_measurable.not_applicable: Answered by people; no system pre-check.

executive_decisions_visible.pass: Open decisions have a named owner.
executive_decisions_visible.unknown: No open decision is recorded yet.
executive_decisions_visible.not_applicable: Answered by people; no system pre-check.

warnings.charter__top_outcomes_count: The charter should name 3 to 5 top outcomes.

versions.title: Version history
versions.intro: Every saved change is an immutable version. Compare a version with the one before it.
versions.noFieldChange: No charter field changed between these versions.
versions.previousMissing: The previous version is not available.
